items.q: Fill up: Renal plasma flow (700 ml) is estimated using para amino hippuric acid, abbreviated ______.
items.exp: RPF = 700 ml: estimated using para amino hippuric acid (PAH). (Book p738)

items.q: The filtration fraction computed as 125/700 equals:
Fill up: A raised filtration fraction increases peritubular capillary oncotic pressure, taking fluid from the interstitial space and lowering renal interstitial ______, which boosts PCT reabsorption.
items.exp: ↑ FF → ↑ peritubular capillary OP → taken-in fluid from interstitial space → ↓ renal interstitial HP (RIHP) → ↑ reabsorption from PCT. (Book p738)

items.q: Which of the following statements about pressure natriuresis is TRUE?
opts: A raised cardiac output increases excretion of Na+ and H2O
A raised cardiac output decreases sodium excretion
items.exp: ↑ CO leads to ↑ excretion of Na+ & H2O; therefore ↑ CO cannot produce sustained ↑ BP unless there is renal impairment. (Book p738)

items.q: The book's pressure-natriuresis caveat uses which blood-pressure identity?
items.exp: Therefore, ↑ CO cannot produce sustained ↑ in BP unless there is renal impairment (BP = CO × PVR). (Book p738)
